qc.label_under_test: the word that opens a time-span quantity ('in one to two weeks', 'over three days', 'in the first half of'), on the token before the number or unit

neighbours.label: the word that opens a time-span quantity ('in one to two weeks', 'over three days', 'in the first half of'), on the token before the number or unit
fire: The seedlings sprout in two to three weeks.
The swelling should ease over four days.
Results will come in the second half of the year.
The eggs hatch in one to two weeks.
The fever may last over five days.
We expect a decision in the first half of June.
Kittens open their eyes in one to two weeks.
Prices will rise over the next three months.
quiet: The seedlings sprout in two or three rows.
The swelling should ease with cold water.
Results will come in a second letter from the lab.
The eggs hatch in one or two nests.
The bridge may span over five rivers.
We expect a decision from the first judge.
Kittens open their eyes in a dark box.
Prices will rise over the next three stores.

notes: Registered as a dispute: in probes only 'in one to four weeks' fired (0.63), while 'over three days' read 0.07 and 'in the first half' 0.05. So I expect the general 'time-span' label to fail. The fire set uses the label's own forms.
